sections.content: Use por eso, por lo tanto, así que and como resultado to explain consequences.

items.spanish: Había poco tiempo, por eso salimos temprano.
items.english: There was little time, so we left early.

items.spanish: El precio subió; como resultado, muchas personas cambiaron de plan.
items.english: The price went up; as a result, many people changed their plans.

items.spanish: Faltaba transporte; por lo tanto, los comerciantes tuvieron problemas.
items.english: There was a lack of transport; therefore, the shopkeepers had problems.
